body:
WHAT
When the engine sends a `question_request` (a card asking the user to choose or approve), the renderer first closes the assistant message that was streaming, which converts its plain live text into rendered Markdown. So the text above the card is formatted while the user is still deciding.

WHY
Live text is plain until the message closes; without this the text sat as raw Markdown source until the whole turn ended.

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/landing.js — onQuestionRequest(event) calls finalizeAssistantEl() before building the card; handleEngineEvent case "question_request". app/renderer/modules/stream.js — finalizeAssistantEl() (removes the caret, renders el._raw with renderMarkdown into .msg-body, sets currentAssistantEl = null).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. After text deltas '**bold** text\n\nmore' and then a question_request event, the previous assistant element contains a <strong> node and no .caret, and currentAssistantEl is null before the card is appended.
2. The question card is appended after the finalized message in DOM order (transcript stays chronological).
3. A text delta arriving after the question_request creates a new assistant element rather than appending to the finalized one.
4. If renderMarkdown throws for the raw text, the plain text already on screen is kept (message never vanishes).
5. The captured ownerTabId at question time is used when the answer is sent, so the response goes to the tab that asked even if focus changed.
